exact_evidence: CAT10864665113 scan leaf 213 is a separate typeset 'Executive Order' page with the amendment's full apparent body, 'WOODROW WILSON,' 'The White House, 30 April, 1919,' and '[No. 3083.]'; leaves 212 and 214 are blank versos with binder holes, and leaf 213 has no issuing-office, printer, edition, or publication imprint. The item metadata identifies a 1919 USDA History Collection / National Agricultural Library holding titled 'Assistant/Administrative Assistant to Secretary's Circulars, No. 16-55' but gives no publisher or creator. The leaf proves a contemporaneous-looking government-file copy of a complete numbered order; it does not by itself establish that this particular leaf is an official original issuance/printing rather than an archival reproduction. The held OCR is substantially the leaf's text with minor recognition noise, but that does not resolve provenance.
